registry_snapshot.name: USES_PREVIOUSLY_PRODUCED_ARTIFACT
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent execution command consumes, loads, or invokes an artifact (such as a source file or script) that was produced by an earlier agent action within the same trajectory.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent action that created a persistent artifact.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A later command that loads or executes the previously created artifact.

registry_snapshot.name: REVEALS_MISSING_PREREQUISITE
registry_snapshot.definition: A preliminary environment probe performed by the agent returns evidence that a required tool or runtime is not available for the upcoming task.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An agent probe action that checks for the availability of a required tool or runtime.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An observation reporting that the probed prerequisite is absent from the environment.

registry_snapshot.name: MISSING_PREREQUISITE_CAUSES_EXECUTION_FAILURE
registry_snapshot.definition: A later execution attempt fails to run because it depends on the same prerequisite that an earlier observation reported as missing.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observation indicating that a required prerequisite is missing.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent command execution that fails because that prerequisite is unavailable.

registry_snapshot.name: PLANS_REMEDIATION_FOR_MISSING_PREREQUISITE
registry_snapshot.definition: The agent's plan or decision includes a conditional follow-up step to install or obtain a prerequisite in case an availability check reveals it is missing.
registry_snapshot.source_description: Evidence or anticipation that a required prerequisite may be missing from the environment.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An agent plan or decision to install or obtain the missing prerequisite.

registry_snapshot.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action attempts to resolve a failure or missing prerequisite identified by an earlier execution step so that the blocked operation can proceed.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure or error caused by a missing prerequisite (e.g., a required tool or program not being available).
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to provide the missing prerequisite or otherwise resolve that failure.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_PRODUCED_OUTPUT
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action independently inspects or validates an artifact whose production was reported by an earlier execution step, in order to confirm the reported output actually exists and is well-formed.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier execution result that reports or claims that an output artifact was produced.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent action that independently checks the existence, content, size, or validity of that reported artifact.

registry_snapshot.name: DECIDES_TASK_COMPLETION_FROM_VERIFIED_RESULTS
registry_snapshot.definition: Based on verified successful results for the required deliverables, the agent concludes that the task is complete and finalizes execution.
registry_snapshot.source_description: Verified execution results confirming that the required deliverables exist and behave correctly.
registry_snapshot.target_description: The agent's decision to mark the task as complete and terminate further execution.

registry_snapshot.name: INVESTIGATES_FAILURE_CAUSE
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent diagnostic action gathers information about the cause or environment of an earlier observed failure or blocker.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure, error, or blocker.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent diagnostic action that inspects system state, constraints, or capabilities to determine the cause of that failure.

registry_snapshot.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT_GUIDES_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: A diagnostic observation revealing an environmental constraint or incompatibility directs the selection of a specific corrective action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A diagnostic observation that identifies a constraint, incompatibility, or capability gap.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent repair action selected to satisfy or work around that diagnostic finding.

registry_snapshot.name: SUCCESSFUL_SETUP_ENABLES_SUBSEQUENT_USE
registry_snapshot.definition: A successful installation or environment-setup action makes a capability available that the agent subsequently relies on.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A successful setup or installation action result.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent action that uses the capability made available by that setup.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_OUTCOME_OF_PREVIOUS_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action checks the completion status or result of an earlier action whose outcome is uncertain or asynchronous.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent action whose outcome is uncertain, asynchronous, or needs confirmation.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent check or inspection that determines whether the earlier action completed or produced the expected result.

registry_snapshot.name: CONFLICTING_RESULTS_TRIGGER_DISAMBIGUATING_ANALYSIS
registry_snapshot.definition: Multiple mutually inconsistent outputs produced by alternative methods applied to the same problem prompt the agent to perform additional targeted analysis to determine which result is correct.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A set of divergent or mutually inconsistent results produced by alternative methods or analyses of the same problem.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A follow-up analysis action designed to discriminate among the divergent results and select the correct one.

registry_snapshot.name: REUSES_PRIOR_RESULT_AS_INPUT
registry_snapshot.definition: A result that was previously derived, evaluated, or selected is supplied as an input to a subsequent action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier derived, evaluated, or selected result such as a chosen structure or computed value.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A later action that consumes that earlier result as an input or parameter.

registry_snapshot.name: USES_TEST_SPECIFICATION_TO_GUIDE_SOLUTION
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent examines an existing test harness or evaluation specification to understand how success is measured, and uses that understanding to direct or constrain subsequent solution construction.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An observation or analysis of a test harness, evaluation script, or acceptance criteria.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent plan or action aimed at satisfying the identified success criteria.

registry_snapshot.name: CONFIRMS_PROPOSED_MECHANISM
registry_snapshot.definition: An observed result of an experiment performed to evaluate a proposed mechanism provides evidence that the mechanism behaves as hypothesized, validating the mechanism for subsequent adoption.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An experiment or probe execution performed by the agent to evaluate a proposed mechanism, approach, or prediction.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An observed execution result that provides evidence supporting the expected behavior of the proposed mechanism.

registry_snapshot.name: RESPONDS_TO_FAILED_ATTEMPT_WITH_ALTERNATIVE
registry_snapshot.definition: After an execution attempt fails to accomplish its intended goal (no effect, error, or unavailable tool or module), the agent selects a different action to accomplish the same goal by an alternative mechanism, rather than fixing the condition that caused the failure.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An execution attempt that failed to accomplish its intended goal or produced no usable result.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An alternative agent action intended to accomplish the same goal by a different mechanism.

registry_snapshot.name: RESPONDS_TO_CONFIRMATION_REQUEST
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action provides the explicit confirmation demanded by a tool observation that refused to execute a final, irreversible, or high-impact operation until the agent reconfirmed its intent.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A tool observation that prompts for confirmation before executing a final or high-impact operation instead of carrying it out.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that confirms the operation, typically by re-issuing the original tool call with explicit confirmation.

registry_snapshot.name: REAFFIRMS_PRIOR_CONCLUSION
registry_snapshot.definition: A later agent reasoning step restates a conclusion or justification that was already established by an earlier reasoning step, without adding new evidence or changing the conclusion.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent thought or analysis that states a conclusion or justification.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent thought or analysis that repeats the same conclusion or justification.

registry_snapshot.name: PROBES_ENVIRONMENT_FOR_PREREQUISITES
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent action inspects the runtime environment to determine whether the tools, libraries, or versions required for a planned or in-progress task step are available.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A planned or in-progress task step whose execution depends on external prerequisites such as tools, libraries, or specific versions.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A diagnostic action that reports the presence, versions, or availability status of those prerequisites.

registry_snapshot.name: SCANS_SOURCE_FOR_INCOMPATIBLE_USAGE
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent action systematically searches the source tree to enumerate code locations that use patterns known to be deprecated, removed, or otherwise incompatible with the constraints of the current environment.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An observation establishing a compatibility constraint or requirement, such as a required dependency version or target runtime present in the environment.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A search action that enumerates candidate source locations requiring modification to satisfy that constraint.

registry_snapshot.name: INSPECTS_BUILD_CONFIGURATION
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent action reads a build or packaging configuration artifact to determine the components, extensions, or dependencies that the build or installation process must handle.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A task step that requires building, compiling, or installing a package from source.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An inspection of the build or packaging configuration that defines the required components, extensions, or dependencies.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_REPAIR_SUCCESS
registry_snapshot.definition: After a corrective action modifies, rebuilds, or reinstalls an artifact to resolve an earlier observed failure, a subsequent agent action re-executes the previously failing operation to determine whether the correction actually resolved that failure.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A corrective agent action that modified, rebuilt, or reinstalled an artifact in an attempt to resolve an earlier observed failure.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent re-execution of the previously failing operation or check, performed to confirm that the failure has been resolved.

registry_snapshot.name: NON_FATAL_WARNINGS_ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: Non-fatal warnings reported during an otherwise successful execution step are treated as non-blocking, and the agent continues the workflow without modifying anything to address those warnings.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An execution observation that reports warnings while indicating the step completed successfully.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that continues the workflow without attempting to resolve the reported warnings.

registry_snapshot.name: USES_OBSERVED_RESOURCE_AS_INPUT
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action consumes, operates on, or passes as arguments resources or entities that were enumerated in an earlier observation of the environment.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observation that enumerates available resources, files, or other environment entities (e.g., a directory listing or inventory of identifiers).
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that operates on, passes, or otherwise consumes those enumerated resources as inputs.

accepted_edge_types.name: CONFLICTING_FIELDS_TRIGGER_RULE_BASED_SELECTION
accepted_edge_types.definition: An observation of multiple differing candidate values for the same required field within a source document or record triggers the application of a specified precedence rule to select one value.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An observation showing multiple conflicting candidate values for the same required field in a document or record.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: An agent decision that selects one of the conflicting values according to a predefined precedence rule.

accepted_edge_types.name: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD_TRIGGERS_DEFAULT_ASSIGNMENT
accepted_edge_types.definition: An observation that a required field is absent from source content triggers the assignment of a task-specified default value, such as zero or an empty string.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An observation of source content that lacks a required field.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: An agent decision assigning the specified default value to the missing field.
